slides.title: A price gap is only the start of an investigation
body: Gold contracts differ in lot size, purity, expiry and delivery location; quoted prices alone are not directly comparable.
Apparent opportunities can disappear after fees, delayed entry, liquidity constraints and lifecycle checks.
Historical research also needs strict cutoffs, source provenance and reproducible calculations.
Theme: evidence-first commodity intelligence—test a signal before trusting it.
slides.callout: Challenge: distinguish a measurable price relationship from a supported opportunity.
slides.notes: Problem framing derives from implemented contract normalization, replay and research-integrity checks. No prevalence, market-size or customer-research claim is implied.

slides.title: One workflow from raw files to reproducible evidence
body: Import daily contract files with explicit dates, provenance and rejection reports.
Normalize prices through a versioned Contract Genome; compare exact expiries and futures curves.
Stress relationships using paired scenarios, historical analogs and cost/delay sensitivity.
Replay decisions using only information available at each cutoff.
Export an evidence certificate with preserved data, assumptions, checks and result hashes.
slides.callout: Working local prototype • 13 workspaces • No paid API or required LLM
slides.notes: All listed features are implemented according to README and validation report. There is no brokerage or order execution.

slides.title: A shared research engine behind every workspace
body: Streamlit + Plotly → FastAPI validation → ingestion and Contract Genome
DuckDB + Parquet → exact-contract analytics → scenarios, replay, analogs and sensitivity
Red Team checks → orchestration → SQLite experiment ledger + JSON evidence certificate
Preserved snapshots, configuration, seeds and hashes support deterministic reproduction.
slides.callout: Real and synthetic data remain separate throughout the pipeline.
slides.notes: Recommended visual: four connected stages (Interface → Data & rules → Research & checks → Evidence). DuckDB is the local market-data store; SQLite records experiments. Avoid implying externally secured or tamper-proof evidence.

slides.title: Target users and value hypotheses
body: Candidate users: commodity research desks, quantitative analysts and finance education teams.
Proposed value: a consistent workflow for contract comparison, assumption testing and reviewable research evidence.
Positioning hypothesis: combine contract rules, adverse scenarios and reproducibility in one local tool.
Business-model hypotheses: team licenses, research pilots or educational deployments.
Next validation: user interviews, workflow trials and willingness-to-pay research.
slides.callout: These hypotheses are unvalidated; no customer traction or market-size estimate is claimed.
slides.notes: No market research, interviews, pricing validation, competitive benchmarking or revenue evidence was found in the supplied project documentation. Present this slide explicitly as hypotheses.

slides.title: The next milestone is credible real-history evaluation
body: Obtain genuine daily Bhavcopy history and verified listing/tender calendars.
Complete historical specification hashes and dated fee provenance.
Commission independent methodology review and expand untouched evaluation periods.
Improve calibrated uncertainty and assessment of liquidity and execution feasibility.
Add cancellable background jobs for longer investigations.
slides.callout: Research roadmap: strengthen data and evidence before making execution claims.
slides.notes: These are planned priorities, not implemented features. Calibrated predictive probabilities and persistent cancellable jobs are currently absent.

slides.title: The strongest demo outcome is an honest verdict
body: 84 automated tests passed in the documented 9 October 2026 run.
Synthetic dataset: 2,160 records, four symbols, 12 fictional expiry identities.
Final synthetic investigation: 11 stress classes × 500 paths; Policy C rejected 17 candidate sessions and completed zero trades.
Red Team: 10 passed, 0 failed, 11 not evaluable. Preserved-snapshot reproduction returned matching hashes.
The five supplied annual reports yielded zero daily observations.
slides.callout: Verdict: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE • Real MCX trading performance remains unvalidated.
slides.notes: Source: docs/validation.md, executed validation dated 9 October 2026. These are documented prior checks, not rerun during presentation creation. Synthetic figures establish software behavior, not historical profitability. Real-mode investigation also returned insufficient evidence with zero observations.
